gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Good CRA alignment with Article 14 check and compliance actions. Some accuracy issues with CVE counts and EPSS values. Comprehensive but verbose at ~600 words.

gemini-3-flash.notes: Strong CRA compliance focus with proper Article 14 assessment. Good accuracy on CVE details and EPSS scores. Well-structured with clear exploit assessment and actionable recommendations.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent conciseness while maintaining completeness. Strong CRA alignment and very actionable recommendations with clear priority ordering. Good accuracy on technical details.

analysis: DeepSeek-v3 wins with superior conciseness and actionability while maintaining strong CRA alignment and accuracy. All models correctly identified no Article 14 triggers and provided good exploit assessments, but DeepSeek-v3 delivered the most focused and actionable summary. Gemini-3-Flash was close second with good structure, while Gemini-2.5-Flash was too verbose despite good technical content.
